question: How do I book a private event at Coco Maya in Little Italy?
answer: Share your date, headcount, and event type through the inquiry form on this page and the Coco Maya events team will follow up within 24 hours. Private events range from an intimate dinner for 10 up to a full venue buyout of 180 guests, on the rooftop patio, in the glass atrium, or throughout the space.
